entries.title: Bridge braces: a tabletop model
entries.question: Do triangle braces reduce bending in a paper bridge?
entries.hypothesis: Adding triangular braces will reduce sag under the same small weight.
entries.method: Use paper bridges of equal span and material, change only the braces. Keep the applied weight constant.
entries.observation: ILLUSTRATIVE VALUES ONLY: Unbraced model 8 mm sag, braced model 3 mm sag. Actual measurements must be recorded by the learner.
entries.conclusion: In this synthetic example the braced paper model sagged less. This is not a construction certification.
entries.nextStep: Repeat with two more identical models, note any uncontrolled variation and calculate an average.
